shellCommands.command: grep -rln "PrefetchKind" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "prefetchProp\|prefetch === true\|prefetch !== false" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/

curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -c "Loading category" ; echo "---full-prefetch-payload---"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -o "Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Loading category" | sort -u
curl -s -L -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -o "Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Loading category" | sort | uniq -c

loc=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2); echo "loc=$loc"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" "http://localhost:3100$loc" -o /tmp/p3.txt -w "code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"; grep -o "Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Loading category" /tmp/p3.txt | sort | uniq -c

curl -s -D /tmp/h5.txt -H "RSC: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=" -o /tmp/p5.txt -w "code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"; grep -i "location\|x-nextjs" /tmp/h5.txt; grep -o "Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Loading category" /tmp/p5.txt | sort | uniq -c

curl -s -H "RSC: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured&_rsc=" | grep -o "Featured products\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket" | sort -u; echo "--- home links ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'href="[^"]*"'
